Core pathways of glucose metabolism and their dynamic synergistic networks

Core pathways of glucose metabolism and their dynamic synergistic networks. Glucose metabolism integrates glycolysis, the tricarboxylic acid (TCA) cycle, and amino acid and lipid synthesis. Insulin activates the PI3K–Akt–mTOR pathway to enhance glucose uptake and glycolysis, whereas glucagon promotes gluconeogenesis through the cAMP–PKA cascade. The TCA cycle acts as a metabolic hub linking carbohydrate, amino acid, and lipid metabolism through acetyl-CoA and key intermediates
